text: Devil is a Christian cosmological concept. The Celts had no image of an evil force. Their image resembled the Christian Devil in no way. The Celtic worldview was ambiguous. It was non-dualistic. Dark balanced light. The two did not wage war. Christianization changed the picture. Some Celtic divinities became negative forces under the new religion. This is a common process. The gods of one religion become the devils of the next. Cernunnos shaped the Christian devil's image. Cernunnos was the Continental god of wilderness. His horns and partially animal body were the main inspiration. Demonized goddesses drew the name Devil's Mother. The concept grew from Celtic roots after conversion. The change followed conversion to Christianity. Old deities found new roles in the new faith. The Devil concept carried Celtic traces forward.
objective: Explain the Celtic origin of the Christian Devil concept.
